sections.value:
## A) Verdict

PASS for PR #246 at e56cb949d907dd41e9e77a52b64374f21928a851.
Final round under C34. No blocking correctness findings, required fixes or further review round.

## B) Scope

Reviewed the repair delta from f3784caab656c1665c2daa469b283f60b2aa0065 to the full head above, the original findings, the affected daemon reason producers, both human rendering call sites, regression tests and updated documentation.

## C) Repair verification

S246-001: the plan's execution guardrail now names a portable sibling worktree rather than an identifying absolute path. Source and generated Markdown agree. A scoped plan-artifact scan found no absolute home-directory paths.

S246-002: cache_route_line now obtains its reason and fix through public_cache_reason. Known sidecar states receive fixed descriptions and repairs rather than sidecar-supplied text. Unknown states and reasons point to cache-proxy status without echoing their inputs. Transport failures retain only a fixed head; their retained repairs are fixed daemon strings, verified against the producers. Known daemon-built route/model reasons retain their established presentation. render::line still fences what is displayed.

The directory holder renderer uses the same projection for plain-route reasons and discards its fix. Proxied rows retain their fixed label; absent route data still adds nothing.

## D) Correctness and compatibility

No round-two change to spawn/revive dispatch, emit_seat_receipt, the success/JSON condition, raw-envelope handling or cheap-compaction sequencing. The projection borrows display text and does not mutate descriptor data. JSON therefore retains the original raw cache_proxy fields, while refusals and JSON output still add no receipt line.

No normal-use correctness regression found in the repair delta.

## E) Regression quality

the_receipt_line_never_shows_the_account_or_a_local_path checks exact identity-free output for account-bearing token/quota failures, path-bearing configuration/transport failures, an unknown state, an unknown reason and multiline forged text. The former verbatim renderer would retain those inputs and fail the new expected-output assertions; no executed mutation run is claimed.

The existing route-format test and directory-holder test also passed. As in round one, these unit tests do not independently prove both CLI receipt call sites; that bounded coverage limitation does not require new hardening or another review round.

## F) Cost

Zero additional steady-state launches/second. No new poll, timer, recurring hook, sweep, request or process launch. The repair adds bounded in-process prefix/state comparisons per human receipt or rendered holder. Neither a destructive policy nor a brake: display projection only. No live fleet-rate measurement is claimed.

## G) Validation

- just pr-freeze 246 --worktree: FINAL at the full reviewed head; CLEAN, main base, latest checks passed, no migration changes.
- git diff --check f3784caab656c1665c2daa469b283f60b2aa0065..HEAD: passed.
- just shared-build --timeout 2 -- test --locked -p pij-cli --bin pij-rs --then clippy --locked -p pij-cli --all-targets -- -D warnings: passed with PIJ_SHARED_TARGET selecting the existing shared target. All 82 CLI binary tests passed, including both receipt tests and the directory-holder test; macOS all-target clippy was clean. The wrapper serialized work at nice 19 with four jobs/test threads.
- CI run 44430351257, Rust job 135245837397: 2,509 passed, six skipped. Rust lint and both JS jobs passed. The latest delivers run also passed.
- harness checks --quick: exit 1 in the dependency-free review worktree. Seven JS-dependent sensors could not pass without local tools; lint resolved an incompatible ambient Biome. Pij-skill and native Copilot contracts passed; heavy stages were skipped. Exact-head CI supplies JS evidence. No dependencies were installed or borrowed, and no full local gate pass is claimed.
- Canonical-checkout harness boot passed readiness/typecheck/smoke; baseline orientation only, not exact-head PR proof.

## H) Handover and harness feedback

Both requested repairs are verified within this correctness review. Product sources remain unchanged by review. Use this final verdict only for the full head above.

magicWand: retain round one's optional fake-daemon stdout regression suggestion so receipt/directory call-site removal can be detected without live seat creation. Captured the final-round proof boundary as INS-001 in bucket pr246-review-r2. No new mandatory follow-up.

difficulties: the dependency-free quick-gate limitation persists; exact-head CI and serialized local Rust validation keep the proof boundary explicit.
